normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cloth over bread, then move to a book that holds a whole subject.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从盖住面包的一块布开始，再到一本包住整门学问的书。

normal.en: Co- plus over: something laid all over the top.
normal.cn: co- 加 over：把东西整个铺在上面。

normal.en: A lid covers a pot, and a cloth covers bread.
normal.cn: 盖子盖住锅，布盖住面包。

normal.en: A book covers a subject the way a sheet covers a bed.
normal.cn: 书涵盖一门学问，就像床单盖住一张床。

normal.en: Reporters cover a story by standing right over it.
normal.cn: 记者报道一件事，就是站到它正上方去看。

normal.en: The cover is the door of a book.
normal.cn: 封面就是一本书的门。

abstract.en: Picture a sheet shaken open above a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布在桌面上方被抖开。

abstract.en: Picture snow covering a whole field in one night.
abstract.cn: 想象一夜之间雪盖住整片田野。

abstract.en: Picture a hand held over a candle flame.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手挡在烛焰上方。

examples.en: Dust covered every shelf in the room.
examples.cn: 房间里每个架子上都盖着灰。

examples.en: The course covers both grammar and writing.
examples.cn: 这门课兼含语法与写作。

examples.en: Her photo is on the cover of the magazine.
examples.cn: 她的照片登在杂志封面上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cover 记成 co（共同）加 over（在上面）：一起盖在上面，就是把东西遮住了。

root: 源自拉丁语 cooperire（整个盖住），由 co-（完全）与 operire（关上、遮住）构成，经古法语 covrir 进入英语，本指盖住保护，后引申为涵盖、报道与封面。

sensesIntro.en: From a cloth laid over bread, to a book that holds a subject, to the front that faces you.
sensesIntro.cn: 从盖在面包上的布，到包住一门学问的书，最后到正对着你的那一面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloth spread over everything on a table.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块布铺开，盖住桌上的所有东西。

branches.en: The cloth hides and protects what lies under it.
branches.cn: 布把下面的东西遮住，也保护起来。

branches.en: A wide enough cloth holds a whole range of things.
branches.cn: 布够大，就能兜住一整套内容。

branches.en: The outermost layer is what a reader meets first.
branches.cn: 最外面那一层，是读者最先遇到的东西。

branches.en: Covering and including both mean taking something in.
branches.cn: 遮盖与包含，都是把东西收进来。

branches.en: A book covers a subject and shows its cover to the world.
branches.cn: 书包住一门学问，又把封面亮给世人。

intro.en: Cover grows from the Latin hiding base oper-, which also gives discover and uncover.
intro.cn: cover 从拉丁语表示遮盖的词基 oper- 长出来，discover 与 uncover 也由它构成。

latinIntro.en: The base operire still hides inside cover, covert and discover.
latinIntro.cn: 词基 operire 至今仍藏在 cover、covert 与 discover 里。

items.example: The road was covered with leaves.
A thin covering of snow lay outside.
The coverage of the match was wide.
items.exampleCN: 这场比赛的报道范围很广。
她把床罩叠得整整齐齐。

items.meaning: to take the cover off and find

items.exampleCN: 他揭开了那口老井的盖。

definition_en: a large female farm animal kept for milk, or to frighten someone
core_image: 一头黑白花的大牛站在草地上，尾巴来回甩动
scene: 清晨牧场上的黑白花大牛慢慢抬起头，嘴里还在嚼草。The cow stood still while the farmer milked it.
sceneCN: 这里 cow 指「奶牛」（第 2 个义项：养来产奶的牛）；句意是农夫挤奶时那头牛一动不动。

senses.title: The female of cattle
senses.definition: a large adult female of cattle
senses.definitionCN: 成年的大型雌性牛
senses.example: A cow and her calf stood in the shade.
senses.exampleCN: 一头母牛和小牛站在阴凉里。
senses.why: The female of the herd carries the next generation.
senses.whyCN: 牛群里的雌性承载着下一代。

senses.title: The animal that gives milk
senses.definition: a cow kept on a farm for its milk
senses.definitionCN: 养在农场里用来产奶的牛
senses.example: The farmer milks every cow at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫天亮时给每头奶牛挤奶。
senses.why: Milk turns a field into a daily gift.
senses.whyCN: 牛奶把一片草地变成每天的礼物。

senses.title: To frighten into obedience
senses.definition: to make someone afraid so that they obey
senses.definitionCN: 使人害怕从而服从
senses.example: He was cowed by the shouting.
senses.exampleCN: 他被那阵吼叫吓住了。
senses.why: Fear bends a person the way a yoke bends a neck.
senses.whyCN: 恐惧把人压弯，就像轭把脖子压弯。

intro.en: Cow goes back to Old English cu, from a very old Indo-European word for cattle.
intro.cn: cow 可追溯到古英语 cu，其更早来源是一个表示牛的古老印欧词。

items.en: An old root named cattle and could mean wealth.
items.cn: 一个古老词根指牛群，也可以表示财富。

items.en: The root became kuz in the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个词根在日耳曼诸语中变成 kuz。

items.en: Cu named the female of cattle.
items.cn: cu 指雌性的牛。

items.en: Cow stayed the everyday word for the milking animal.
items.cn: cow 一直是称呼产奶牛的口常词。

items.en: The verb to cow grew from the picture of a bent neck.
items.cn: 动词「恐吓」由脖子被压弯的形象引申而来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close to cow in spelling, and the meaning group names other cattle words.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写接近 cow 的词，近义组列出其他与牛有关的说法。

entries.definition: a person who runs from danger
to bend down low in fear
a hood that covers the head
cows and bulls kept in a herd
the male of cattle
a castrated bull used for work

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a slow animal chewing grass, then move to milk and to a bent neck.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一头慢慢嚼草的动物开始，再到牛奶，最后到被压弯的脖子。

normal.en: A cow stands in the field all day and turns grass into milk.
normal.cn: 母牛整天站在田里，把草变成奶。

normal.en: One cow, one calf: the herd begins with two.
normal.cn: 一头母牛一头小牛，牛群就从两头开始。

normal.en: The word is short and low, like the animal's low call.
normal.cn: 这个词又短又低，像牛发出的低沉叫声。

normal.en: To cow a person is to make their neck bend.
normal.cn: 恐吓一个人，就是让他的脖子弯下去。

normal.en: A cowboy is simply a boy who works with cows.
normal.cn: 牛仔不过就是和牛打交道的男孩。

abstract.en: Picture a black and white animal with a slow swinging tail.
abstract.cn: 想象一头黑白花、尾巴慢悠悠甩动的动物。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden bucket filling with warm milk.
abstract.cn: 想象一只木桶装满温热的奶。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy head lowered under a shouting voice.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗沉重的头在吼声中低下去。

examples.en: The cow chewed grass beside the fence.
examples.cn: 母牛在篱笆边嚼草。

examples.en: Every morning he milks the cows before six.
examples.cn: 每天早上六点前他给奶牛挤奶。

examples.en: She refused to be cowed by their threats.
examples.cn: 她拒绝被他们的威胁吓倒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cow 记成「靠」：牧场上靠着一头大母牛，慢慢嚼着草。

root: 源自古英语 cu（母牛），可追到原始日耳曼语与更早的印欧词根；动词「恐吓」由「把脖子压弯」的形象引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: From the female of the herd to the milk she gives, and at last to the fear that bends a neck.
sensesIntro.cn: 从牛群里的雌性，到她给出的牛奶，最后到把脖子压弯的恐惧。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy black and white animal standing in grass.
core.cn: 核心意象：一头黑白花的大牲口站在草地里。

branches.en: The adult female is the centre of the herd.
branches.cn: 成年的雌性是牛群的中心。

branches.en: Her milk feeds a farm every single morning.
branches.cn: 她的奶每个清晨养活一座农场。

branches.en: Fear works like a yoke on the neck of a person.
branches.cn: 恐惧像轭一样压在人脖子上。

branches.en: The animal and her gift share one short name.
branches.cn: 这动物和她的馈赠共用一个短词。

branches.en: Something gentle can still be forced to kneel.
branches.cn: 温顺的东西也可能被逼得跪下。

intro.en: Cow is a short base word that builds compounds with boy, hide, hand and bell.
intro.cn: cow 是个短词根，与 boy、hide、hand、bell 等组合成复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin named the same animal bos, a word kept in bovine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 bos 称呼同一种动物，这个词保留在 bovine 里。

items.example: They felt cowed by the crowd.
His cowing of the staff failed.
items.exampleCN: 他吓唬员工的做法没成功。

items.example: The bag is made of cowhide.

items.meaning: a bell hung on a cow
items.example: The cowbell rang across the field.

definition_en: a thin line where something has broken, or to break with a sharp sound
core_image: 冰面上出现一道细长的白痕，越裂越长
scene: 脚一踩，湖面的冰立刻裂开一道细长的白线。The thin ice cracked under his boots.
sceneCN: 这里 crack 指「裂开」（第 2 个义项：因受力而出现裂缝）；句意是薄冰在他靴子下裂开了。

senses.title: A thin broken line
senses.definition: a thin line where something has broken but not fallen apart
senses.definitionCN: 物体破裂却还没散开时留下的细线
senses.example: There is a crack in the ceiling.
senses.exampleCN: 天花板上有一道裂缝。
senses.why: A hard thing gives a little, not all at once.
senses.whyCN: 硬东西会先让一点，不会一下子全碎。

senses.title: To break with a sound
senses.definition: to break with a sharp sound, or to develop a thin line
senses.definitionCN: 伴随脆响而破裂，或出现一道细纹
senses.example: The cup cracked when it hit the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 杯子砸到地上时裂了。
senses.why: Stone shouts when it finally gives way.
senses.whyCN: 石头最终让步时，会喊出一声。

senses.title: To solve something hard
senses.definition: to solve a difficult problem or a secret code
senses.definitionCN: 解决难题或破译秘密代码
senses.example: They cracked the code in one night.
senses.exampleCN: 他们一夜之间破解了密码。
senses.why: A hard shell must break before the kernel is reached.
senses.whyCN: 要吃到果仁，硬壳必须先破。

intro.en: Crack comes from Old English cracian, to make a sharp noise, a word shaped by the sound itself.
intro.cn: crack 源自古英语 cracian（发出脆响），这个词本身就是模仿声音造出来的。

items.en: Cracian meant to make a sharp noise.
items.cn: cracian 意为发出尖脆的声响。

items.en: Crack named the sound of something splitting.
items.cn: crack 指东西裂开时的响声。

items.en: It came to name the line left after the sound.
items.cn: 它接着用来指声音过后留下的那道线。

items.en: To crack a code borrowed the sense of breaking a shell.
items.cn: 「破解密码」借用了敲开外壳的意思。

items.en: It now covers cracks, jokes, codes and crackdowns.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖裂缝、笑话、密码与严厉打击。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers sharp-sounding words, and the meaning group names other kinds of break.
note.cn: 形近组收集带尖锐声响的词，近义组列出其他表示破裂的说法。

entries.definition: a loud violent collision
to make small repeated cracking sounds
to make a long high sound when moving
entries.definitionCN: 移动时发出又长又尖的响声

entries.definition: to divide along a line
a break in bone or hard material
an empty space between two things

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a sharp sound, then move to the line it leaves and to a code broken open.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一声脆响开始，再到它留下的细线，最后到被敲开的密码。

normal.en: Say the word aloud: crack already sounds like breaking.
normal.cn: 把这词念出来，crack 本身就带着裂开的响声。

normal.en: A crack is the echo of a break frozen in place.
normal.cn: 裂缝就是一次断裂被冻住的回声。

normal.en: A cup cracks before it ever falls apart.
normal.cn: 杯子在彻底碎掉之前会先裂。

normal.en: To crack a code is to break its hard shell.
normal.cn: 破解密码，就是敲开它坚硬的外壳。

normal.en: A cracker is named for the sound it makes between your teeth.
normal.cn: 饼干的名字，来自它在牙间发出的那声脆响。

abstract.en: Picture a white line running across grey ice.
abstract.cn: 想象一道白线在灰冰上延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a hairline scar on a porcelain plate.
abstract.cn: 想象瓷盘上一道发丝般的裂痕。

abstract.en: Picture a locked box opening with a small snap.
abstract.cn: 想象一只锁着的箱子啪一声开了。

examples.en: A crack ran across the frozen pond.
examples.cn: 一道裂缝横穿结冰的池塘。

examples.en: The branch cracked under his weight.
examples.cn: 树枝在他的重量下裂了。

examples.en: She cracked two eggs into the pan.
examples.cn: 她把两个鸡蛋打进锅里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crack 记成「咔嚓」：东西裂开时那一声脆响，就是 crack，声音之后留下裂缝。

root: 源自古英语 cracian（发出脆响），是模拟声音构成的词，本指物体裂开时的声响，后指裂缝本身，又引申出破解与打击等义。

sensesIntro.en: From the sharp sound of breaking, to the line it leaves, to a hard problem solved.
sensesIntro.cn: 从破裂的脆响，到它留下的细线，最后到被解决的难题。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white line splitting a hard surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道白线把硬表面劈开。

branches.en: The line stays because the two sides still hold.
branches.cn: 裂缝留下，是因为两边还撑着。

branches.en: The moment of breaking always makes a noise.
branches.cn: 破裂的那一刻总会发出一声。

branches.en: A secret is a shell, and solving it is cracking it open.
branches.cn: 秘密是一只壳，解开它就是把它敲开。

branches.en: Sound and line are two records of the same event.
branches.cn: 声音和细线，是同一件事的两份记录。

branches.en: Both a cup and a code can give way suddenly.
branches.cn: 杯子和密码都可能突然让步。

intro.en: Crack is an imitative base word that grows tools, actions and compounds with down and pot.
intro.cn: crack 是模拟声音的词根，可与表示工具、动作以及 down、pot 的词素组合。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the word is native English, shaped by sound.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，是英语本族词，由声音模仿而成。

items.meaning: a thin break or its sound
items.meaningCN: 细裂缝或它发出的响声

items.meaning: the act of breaking or solving
items.example: The cracking of the code took hours.
items.exampleCN: 破解密码花了几个小时。

items.example: He ate a cracker with cheese.
items.exampleCN: 他就着奶酪吃了一块饼干。

items.example: They called the inventor a crackpot.
items.exampleCN: 他们管那位发明家叫怪人。

definition_zh: 手艺；工艺；手工艺品；船；飞行器
definition_en: skill in making things by hand, an object made that way, or a boat or aircraft
core_image: 一双手把一团泥慢慢收成一只薄壁的碗
scene: 老人把一团泥放在转盘上，双手一收，碗壁就薄了下来。Pottery is a craft that takes years to learn.
sceneCN: 这里 craft 指「手艺」（第 1 个义项：手工制作的技艺）；句意是制陶是一门需要多年才能学会的手艺。

pos.zh: 手艺；工艺；手工艺品；船；飞行器

senses.title: Skill in the hands
senses.definition: skill in making things with the hands
senses.definitionCN: 用双手制作物品的技艺
senses.example: Weaving baskets is a craft.
senses.exampleCN: 编篮子是一门手艺。
senses.why: Skill leaves the head and settles in the fingers.
senses.whyCN: 本事从脑子里下来，住进了手指里。

senses.title: Something made by hand
senses.definition: an object made by hand with skill
senses.definitionCN: 用技艺手工做成的物件
senses.example: The shelf is full of local crafts.
senses.exampleCN: 架子上摆满了本地的手工艺品。
senses.why: Each object keeps the shape of the hand that made it.
senses.whyCN: 每件物品都留着做它的那只手的形状。

senses.title: A boat or aircraft
senses.definition: a boat, ship or aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 小船、轮船或飞行器
senses.example: A small craft waited by the pier.
senses.exampleCN: 一只小船等在码头边。
senses.why: A vessel is also a made thing, shaped by skill.
senses.whyCN: 船同样是靠手艺造出来的东西。

intro.en: Craft goes back to Old English cræft, meaning strength, power or skill.
intro.cn: craft 可追溯到古英语 cræft，意为力量、能力或本领。

items.en: Cræft meant strength, power or skill.
items.cn: cræft 意为力量、能力或技艺。

items.en: The same root gave German Kraft, strength.
items.cn: 同一个词根在德语中变成 Kraft，意为力量。

items.en: Craft came to mean skill in making things.
items.cn: craft 转而指制作物品的技艺。

items.en: Craft also named a boat, a thing built with skill.
items.cn: craft 又开始指船，即靠技艺造出的东西。

items.en: It now covers hand skills, small vessels and clever making.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖手工技艺、小船与精心的制作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words near craft in shape, and the meaning group names other words for skilled work.
note.cn: 形近组收集形状接近 craft 的词，近义组列出其他表示技艺与行业的说法。

entries.definition: clever in a way that hides the truth
a first rough version of a text
a piece of living tissue joined to another
the ability to do something well
a job that needs skilled hands
the making of beautiful things

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with clay on a wheel, then move to a shelf of made things and to a small boat.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从转盘上的泥开始，再到一架子手作，最后到一只小船。

normal.en: Craft first meant strength, and strength moved into the fingers.
normal.cn: craft 最初指力量，后来这股力量走进了手指。

normal.en: A crooked bowl still shows the hand that made it.
normal.cn: 一只歪碗也还看得出做它的那只手。

normal.en: Practise a craft daily and the hands remember.
normal.cn: 每天练一门手艺，手就会记住。

normal.en: A small craft on the water is a boat built by skill.
normal.cn: 水面上的小船，就是靠技艺造出来的船。

normal.en: To craft a plan is to shape it like clay.
normal.cn: 精心制定计划，就是像捏泥一样把它塑出来。

abstract.en: Picture ten fingers closing around wet clay.
abstract.cn: 想象十根手指合拢在一块湿泥上。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden shelf of bowls, each slightly different.
abstract.cn: 想象一木架碗，每只都略有不同。

abstract.en: Picture a thin hull sliding into grey water.
abstract.cn: 想象一只薄壳船滑进灰色的水里。

examples.en: She learned the craft of glass blowing.
examples.cn: 她学会了吹玻璃的手艺。

examples.en: The crafts on sale were all made by hand.
examples.cn: 出售的手工艺品全是手工做的。

examples.en: The harbour held a hundred small craft.
examples.cn: 港口停着一百只小船。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 craft 记成 c（手）加 raft（筏子）：用手扎出一只筏子，靠的就是手艺。

root: 源自古英语 cræft（力量、技能），与德语 Kraft（力量）同源，本指力气与本领，后专指手工技艺，又用来指靠技艺造出的船与飞行器。

sensesIntro.en: From skill in the fingers, to the object made, to the vessel shaped by that skill.
sensesIntro.cn: 从手指里的技艺，到做成的物件，最后到靠这门技艺造出的船。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands drawing a shape out of soft clay.
core.cn: 核心意象：双手从软泥里拉出一个形状。

branches.en: Skill lives in repeated motion until it becomes sure.
branches.cn: 技艺活在反复的动作里，直到变得稳妥。

branches.en: The finished object carries the marks of its maker.
branches.cn: 做成的东西带着制作者的印记。

branches.en: Even a boat is a hand-shaped thing on water.
branches.cn: 连船也只是水上一件用手塑成的东西。

branches.en: Skill and object are the cause and the proof.
branches.cn: 技艺是因，物件是证。

branches.en: From a bowl to a boat, all are made by the same care.
branches.cn: 从碗到船，都出自同一种用心。

intro.en: Craft is a native base word that joins man, work and ship to name people and products.
intro.cn: craft 是本族词根，可与 man、work、ship 等组合，指人与制品。

latinIntro.en: No Latin source is needed: craft is Germanic, like German Kraft.
latinIntro.cn: 它无需拉丁来源：craft 属日耳曼语，与德语 Kraft 同源。

items.exampleCN: 集市上展出本地手工艺品。

items.meaning: the act of making by hand
items.exampleCN: 手工制作需要安静的几个小时。

items.meaning: a person skilled in a craft

items.exampleCN: 这张桌子显出精湛的做工。

items.example: A crafty answer avoided the question.
items.exampleCN: 一个狡猾的回答绕开了问题。

definition_en: a tall machine that lifts heavy loads, a long-legged bird, or to stretch your neck
core_image: 一台吊机的长臂伸向天空，像一只立在工地的白鹤
scene: 他伸长脖子，从人群头顶去看台上的表演。She craned her neck to see over the crowd.
sceneCN: 这里 crane 指「伸长脖子」（第 3 个义项：把脖子尽量探出去）；句意是她伸长脖子从人群上方张望。

senses.title: The machine with a long arm
senses.definition: a tall machine with a long arm that lifts heavy loads
senses.definitionCN: 有长臂、能吊起重物的高机器
senses.example: A crane lifted the steel beams.
senses.exampleCN: 一台起重机把钢梁吊了起来。
senses.why: A long arm and a hook do the work of a hundred men.
senses.whyCN: 一条长臂加一个钩，干了上百人的活。

senses.title: The tall long-necked bird
senses.definition: a tall bird with long legs and a long neck
senses.definitionCN: 腿长脖子长的高大鸟类
senses.example: A crane stood in the shallow water.
senses.exampleCN: 一只鹤站在浅水里。
senses.why: The bird is the living model of the machine.
senses.whyCN: 这只鸟就是那台机器的活模型。

senses.title: To stretch the neck
senses.definition: to stretch your neck so as to see something
senses.definitionCN: 把脖子探出去以便看清某物
senses.example: She craned her neck to see the stage.
senses.exampleCN: 她伸长脖子去看舞台。
senses.why: The body copies the bird's long neck for a moment.
senses.whyCN: 人一时把身体学成了那只鸟的长脖子。

intro.en: Crane comes from Old English cran, the long-necked bird; the machine took its name from the bird's shape.
intro.cn: crane 源自古英语 cran（长颈的鸟）；起重机因形状像鹤而得名。

items.en: Cran named the long-necked bird.
items.cn: cran 指长脖子的鸟。

items.en: The bird name is shared with German Kranich.
items.cn: 这个鸟名与德语 Kranich 同源。

items.en: Crane stayed the name of the bird alone.
items.cn: crane 那时还只指这种鸟。

items.en: The lifting machine took its name from the bird's shape.
items.cn: 起吊机器因形似鹤而借用了这个名字。

items.en: The verb now means to stretch the neck like that bird.
items.cn: 动词义指像那只鸟一样伸长脖子。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words near crane in shape, and the meaning group names other lifting and long-legged words.
note.cn: 形近组收集形状接近 crane 的词，近义组列出与起吊、长腿有关的说法。

entries.definition: a large wooden box for transport
a handle turned to start a machine
entries.definitionCN: 转动以启动机器的把手

entries.definition: a coloured stick for drawing
to lift something heavy with ropes
a long-legged bird that hunts fish
to raise something to a higher place

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a long neck by the water, then move to a long arm on a building site.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从水边一条长脖子开始，再到工地上一只长臂。

normal.en: The bird and the machine share one long line.
normal.cn: 鸟和机器共用一条长长的线。

normal.en: A crane on a site looks like a heron waiting for fish.
normal.cn: 工地上的吊车，像一只等鱼的鹭。

normal.en: Fold a paper crane and you fold the bird's neck.
normal.cn: 折一只纸鹤，就是折这只鸟的脖子。

normal.en: When you crane your neck, you borrow the bird for a second.
normal.cn: 你伸长脖子时，就短暂借用了这只鸟。

normal.en: Heavy steel moves because one arm is long enough.
normal.cn: 沉重的钢能移动，只因为那条臂够长。

abstract.en: Picture a narrow neck rising above tall grass.
abstract.cn: 想象一条细脖子从高草里升起来。

abstract.en: Picture a hook hanging from a high steel arm.
abstract.cn: 想象一个钩子挂在高高的钢臂下。

abstract.en: Picture a row of heads all turning upward.
abstract.cn: 想象一排脑袋同时向上转。

examples.en: The crane lowered the container onto the ship.
examples.cn: 吊车把集装箱放到船上。

examples.en: Cranes fly north in early spring.
examples.cn: 鹤在早春向北飞。

examples.en: He craned forward to catch her words.
examples.cn: 他探着身子向前，想听清她的话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crane 记成「长颈」：鹤的长脖子和吊车的长臂，本就是同一个形状。

root: 源自古英语 cran（鹤），与德语 Kranich 同源；起重机因长臂形似鹤颈而得名，动词「伸长脖子」也由鹤的姿态引申。

sensesIntro.en: From the bird's long neck to the machine's long arm, and at last to the neck we stretch.
sensesIntro.cn: 从鹤的长脖子，到机器的长臂，最后到我们自己伸出的脖子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one long neck rising above a flat place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条长脖子从平地上高高立起。

branches.en: The machine borrows the bird's long reach for steel.
branches.cn: 机器借了鸟的长臂去搬钢。

branches.en: The bird stands still and strikes with its neck.
branches.cn: 鹤站着不动，用脖子出击。

branches.en: A person copies that reach with the whole body.
branches.cn: 人用整个身体去学那种探伸。

branches.en: Machine and bird are both defined by one long line.
branches.cn: 机器与鸟都靠一条长线被认出来。

branches.en: Watching and lifting begin with the same stretch.
branches.cn: 看与吊，都从同一个伸展动作开始。

intro.en: Crane is a bird name that moved to machines and to the verb of stretching.
intro.cn: crane 本是鸟名，后来转到机器上，又变成伸脖子的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin called the bird grus, a name kept in the English word gruiform.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语称这种鸟为 grus，这个名字保留在英语词 gruiform 里。

items.meaning: a lifting machine or a tall bird

items.example: Three cranes stood in the marsh.
She craned her head around the door.

items.meaning: the act of stretching the neck
items.example: Craning to see, he lost his balance.
items.exampleCN: 他探身去看，结果失了平衡。

items.meaning: a plant with a long seed case
a person who works a crane
items.example: The crane driver waited for a signal.

items.meaning: a skilled worker of a crane
items.example: The crane operator wore a helmet.
items.exampleCN: 吊车操作员戴着安全帽。

definition_en: a violent collision or its sound, or to hit something hard and break
core_image: 两辆车头撞在一起，玻璃碎成一地亮点
scene: 清晨的十字路口，两辆车头撞在一起，玻璃撒了一地。The two cars crashed at the crossing.
sceneCN: 这里 crash 指「碰撞」（第 1 个义项：车辆猛烈相撞）；句意是两辆车在路口撞上了。

senses.title: Two things hitting hard
senses.definition: a violent collision between vehicles or objects
senses.definitionCN: 车辆或物体之间的猛烈相撞
senses.example: The crash blocked the whole road.
senses.exampleCN: 这场碰撞把整条路都堵住了。
senses.why: Two paths meet and both refuse to bend.
senses.whyCN: 两条路线相遇，两边都不肯让。

senses.title: An aircraft coming down
senses.definition: the falling and breaking of an aircraft
senses.definitionCN: 飞行器坠落并损毁
senses.example: The plane crash was a terrible accident.
senses.exampleCN: 那场空难是一场可怕的意外。
senses.why: What flies must also obey the ground.
senses.whyCN: 会飞的东西，也终究要听地面的话。

senses.title: A market falling down
senses.definition: a sudden failure of a market or a system
senses.definitionCN: 市场或系统的突然失效
senses.example: The market crash ruined many families.
senses.exampleCN: 市场崩溃让许多家庭破了产。
senses.why: Numbers can fall as fast as metal can.
senses.whyCN: 数字下坠的速度，不比金属慢。

intro.en: Crash comes from Middle English crasschen, to make a loud clattering noise, a word built from its own sound.
intro.cn: crash 源自中古英语 crasschen（发出噼啪巨响），是照着声音造出来的词。

items.en: Crasschen meant to make a loud clattering noise.
items.cn: crasschen 意为发出响亮的碰撞声。

items.en: Crash named the sound of something breaking.
items.cn: crash 指东西碎裂时的响声。

items.en: It came to name a violent collision itself.
items.cn: 它转而来指猛烈碰撞这件事本身。

items.en: Crash widened to aircraft and to money markets.
items.cn: crash 又扩展到飞机与金融市场。

items.en: It now covers traffic, planes, computers and prices.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖交通、飞机、电脑与价格。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that begin with a hard cr-, and the meaning group names other words for violent impact.
note.cn: 形近组收集以硬辅音 cr- 开头的词，近义组列出其他表示猛烈撞击的说法。

entries.definition: to press something until it breaks
a sharp disagreement or fight
a hard outer layer
the hitting together of two moving things
to break loudly into pieces
a badly damaged ship or vehicle

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two bumpers meeting, then move to a falling plane and to a falling market.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两个保险杠相碰开始，再到坠落的飞机，最后到崩落的市场。

normal.en: Crash sounds like what it means: a hard thing meeting a hard thing.
normal.cn: crash 读起来就像它的意思：硬东西撞上硬东西。

normal.en: Glass tells the story best, because it breaks all at once.
normal.cn: 玻璃最能说明问题，因为它是整片一起碎的。

normal.en: A crash course is a short road driven at full speed.
normal.cn: 速成课就是全速开完的一小段路。

normal.en: A plane crash ends in silence after the noise.
normal.cn: 空难总是在巨响之后归于寂静。

normal.en: Prices crash the way glass does: no warning, then nothing.
normal.cn: 价格崩落像玻璃：没有预告，然后什么都没有。

abstract.en: Picture two metal heads touching at speed.
abstract.cn: 想象两个金属车头高速相触。

abstract.en: Picture a line on a chart dropping straight down.
abstract.cn: 想象图表上一条线笔直落下。

abstract.en: Picture a shower of small bright pieces on the road.
abstract.cn: 想象路面上撒开一片明亮的小碎片。

examples.en: The truck crashed into the fence.
examples.cn: 卡车撞上了篱笆。

examples.en: He survived a plane crash last winter.
examples.cn: 他去年冬天经历了一场空难并活了下来。

examples.en: The stock market crashed in a single day.
examples.cn: 股市在一天之内崩盘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crash 记成「咔嚓」加 sh：撞上去那一声碎响，就是 crash。

root: 源自中古英语 crasschen（发出噼啪巨响），是拟声词，本指物体碎裂的响声，后指猛烈碰撞，近代又扩展到飞机坠毁与市场崩溃。

sensesIntro.en: From two cars meeting to a plane coming down and a market losing its floor.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两车相撞，到飞机坠落，最后到市场失去支撑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hard fronts meeting with a burst of glass.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个坚硬的车头相撞，玻璃四溅。

branches.en: Two moving things reach the same point at once.
branches.cn: 两个运动的东西同时到达同一点。

branches.en: What flies can lose the air under it.
branches.cn: 会飞的东西也会失去身下的空气。

branches.en: A system built on numbers can fall like metal.
branches.cn: 建立在数字上的系统也能像金属一样跌落。

branches.en: Both end with broken parts on the ground.
branches.cn: 两者都以碎片落地收场。

branches.en: The same word covers a lost plane and a lost fortune.
branches.cn: 同一个词既说失事的飞机，也说失去的财富。

intro.en: Crash is an imitative base word that builds compounds with course, landing and proof.
intro.cn: crash 是拟声词根，可与 course、landing、proof 等组合成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word is native English; Latin offers no source for this crash.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是英语本族词，拉丁语并不能给它提供来源。

items.example: The waves crashed on the rocks.
A crashing sound came from the hall.
A party crasher ate all the cake.
items.exampleCN: 一个闯入者吃光了蛋糕。

items.meaning: a short fast course of study
items.example: He took a crash course in Spanish.
items.exampleCN: 他上了一门西班牙语速成课。

items.meaning: a landing that damages the aircraft
items.example: The pilot made a crash landing.

definition_en: to move on hands and knees, to move very slowly, or a fast way of swimming
core_image: 一个婴儿贴在地上，用膝盖和手掌一点点往前挪
scene: 车流堵在路上，只能一米一米地往前挪。Traffic crawled through the tunnel for an hour.
sceneCN: 这里 crawl 指「缓慢行进」（第 2 个义项：车流几乎走不动地往前挪）；句意是车流在隧道里慢慢挪了一个小时。

senses.title: To move on the ground
senses.definition: to move forward on your hands and knees
senses.definitionCN: 用手和膝盖向前移动
senses.example: The baby crawled across the floor.
senses.exampleCN: 婴儿爬过地板。
senses.why: The ground is the first road a body learns.
senses.whyCN: 地面是身体学会的第一条路。

senses.title: To move very slowly
senses.definition: to move very slowly, as traffic does
senses.definitionCN: 像车流那样极慢地移动
senses.example: The queue crawled toward the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍慢慢挪向大门。
senses.why: A crowd in a narrow space moves like one slow animal.
senses.whyCN: 人群挤在窄处，就像一头慢吞吞的动物。

senses.title: The fast swimming stroke
senses.definition: a fast swimming stroke with the face down in the water
senses.definitionCN: 脸朝下、速度最快的一种游泳姿势
senses.example: She swam the crawl across the pool.
senses.exampleCN: 她用自由泳游过了泳池。
senses.why: In water the body lies flat and pulls itself forward.
senses.whyCN: 在水里，身体放平，用手把自己往前拉。

intro.en: Crawl comes from Middle English crawlen, probably from an Old Norse word meaning to claw or scratch.
intro.cn: crawl 源自中古英语 crawlen，很可能来自一个意为用爪抓扒的古诺斯语词。

items.en: Krafla meant to claw or scratch with the hands.
items.cn: krafla 意为用手抓或扒。

items.en: Crawlen meant to move low, pulling with the limbs.
items.cn: crawlen 意为贴低身子、用四肢拉着前进。

items.en: Crawl named the slow creeping of a child.
items.cn: crawl 指孩子缓慢地匍匐前行。

items.en: It widened to slow traffic and to a swimming stroke.
items.cn: 它扩展到缓慢的车流和一种泳姿。

items.en: It now covers babies, queues and the front crawl.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖婴儿、排队的队伍与自由泳。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that rhyme with crawl, and the meaning group names other ways of slow movement.
note.cn: 形近组收集与 crawl 押韵的词，近义组列出其他缓慢移动的说法。

entries.definition: a noisy fight among several people
to speak slowly with long vowels
to write in a quick untidy way
to move slowly and quietly
to go up using hands and feet
to move forward a tiny bit at a time

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a baby on the floor, then move to a queue in a tunnel and to a swimmer.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从地上的婴儿开始，再到隧道里的车流，最后到游泳的人。

normal.en: Crawl begins with a scratching sound: hands pulling at the ground.
normal.cn: crawl 开头带着抓扒的意味：手在地面上拉。

normal.en: A baby crawls before it walks, because the floor is closer.
normal.cn: 婴儿先爬后走，因为地面更近。

normal.en: Traffic that crawls is a long metal animal with no legs.
normal.cn: 缓慢的车流，是一头没有腿的长金属动物。

normal.en: In the front crawl your arms behave like small oars.
normal.cn: 游自由泳时，两条手臂就像两支小桨。

normal.en: Anything moving an inch a minute is crawling.
normal.cn: 任何一分钟只挪一点点的东西，都在 crawl。

abstract.en: Picture small palms pressed flat on a wooden floor.
abstract.cn: 想象小小的手掌平按在木地板上。

abstract.en: Picture a line of red lights moving one metre at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象一串红色尾灯一次只挪一米。

abstract.en: Picture a face turning sideways for a quick breath.
abstract.cn: 想象一张脸侧过去快速换气。

examples.en: The child crawled under the table.
examples.cn: 孩子爬到桌子底下。

examples.en: Cars crawled along the flooded road.
examples.cn: 汽车在积水的路上缓慢行驶。

examples.en: He can swim the crawl for an hour.
examples.cn: 他能用自由泳游一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crawl 记成 cr（抓）加 awl（锥子）：像锥子一样贴着地面，一边抓一边往前。

root: 源自中古英语 crawlen，可能来自古诺斯语 krafla（用爪抓扒），本指贴地用手脚扒着前进，后引申为缓慢移动与一种游泳姿势。

sensesIntro.en: From a body low on the floor to a queue in slow motion and a swimmer pulling water.
sensesIntro.cn: 从贴在地面的身体，到慢动作的车流，最后到划水的泳者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small body close to the ground, pulling itself forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一具贴近地面的小身体把自己往前拉。

branches.en: Hands and knees take turns carrying the body.
branches.cn: 手和膝轮流把身体带向前。

branches.en: A long line of cars moves at the speed of a crawl.
branches.cn: 一长串车以爬行的速度前进。

branches.en: In water the same low posture becomes speed.
branches.cn: 在水里，同样的低姿态变成了速度。

branches.en: Slow and low is the shared picture of both.
branches.cn: 又低又慢，是两者共有的画面。

branches.en: One crawl is slow on land and fast in water.
branches.cn: 同一个词，在陆上慢，在水里快。

intro.en: Crawl is a native base word that builds the agent -er, the adjective -y and compounds with space.
intro.cn: crawl 是本族词根，可加 -er 表人、-y 表性质，并与 space 等构成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic in origin, with no Latin base behind it.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词源自日耳曼语，背后没有拉丁词基。

items.example: He does ten crawls across the pool.
items.exampleCN: 他在泳池里游十个来回。

items.example: The ant crawled up my arm.

items.meaning: a creature or machine that crawls
items.example: A crawler moved along the pipe.
items.exampleCN: 一台履带机器沿管道移动。
那间黑地窖让人心里发毛。

items.meaning: a low space under a house
items.exampleCN: 管道从房屋底下的低层穿过。

items.example: He teaches the front crawl first.

definition_en: mad or unable to think normally, extremely fond of something, or very foolish
core_image: 一个人把椅子顶在头上，在雨里转圈大笑
scene: 他把椅子顶在头上，在雨里转着圈大笑。The neighbours thought he was crazy.
sceneCN: 这里 crazy 指「疯狂的」（第 1 个义项：精神或行为失去常态）；句意是邻居们都觉得他疯了。

senses.title: A mind out of order
senses.definition: mad, or unable to think or behave in a normal way
senses.definitionCN: 精神失常，或无法正常思考和行事
senses.example: The noise nearly drove him crazy.
senses.exampleCN: 那噪声几乎把他逼疯。
senses.why: When the mind loses its order, the body does strange things.
senses.whyCN: 脑子一乱，身体就做出古怪的举动。

senses.title: Wildly fond of something
senses.definition: extremely fond of something or someone
senses.definitionCN: 对某物或某人喜欢到极点
senses.example: She is crazy about old films.
senses.exampleCN: 她对老电影着迷得不得了。
senses.why: Love also takes away the usual measure.
senses.whyCN: 喜欢到极点，也会拿走平常的分寸。

senses.title: A plan without sense
senses.definition: very foolish or unreasonable
senses.definitionCN: 极为愚蠢或不合理的
senses.example: It is a crazy plan that cannot work.
senses.exampleCN: 这是个不可能成功的荒唐计划。
senses.why: A plan without measure looks like a mind without order.
senses.whyCN: 没有分寸的计划，就像没有秩序的脑子。

intro.en: Crazy grows from Middle English crasen, to shatter, so it first meant full of cracks and unsound.
intro.cn: crazy 由中古英语 crasen（碎裂）而来，所以最初意为「满是裂缝、不结实」。

items.en: Crasen meant to break or shatter.
items.cn: crasen 意为打碎或裂开。

items.en: Crazy first meant full of cracks and unsound.
items.cn: crazy 最初指布满裂缝、不牢靠。

items.en: It came to mean a mind that is cracked.
items.cn: 它转而指「裂了缝的脑子」。

items.en: It widened to mean wildly fond of something.
items.cn: 它又扩展为对某物喜欢到发狂。

items.en: It now covers madness, passion and foolish plans.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖发疯、痴迷与荒唐的计划。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words near crazy in shape, and the meaning group names other words for foolish or wild.
note.cn: 形近组收集形状接近 crazy 的词，近义组列出其他表示疯狂与愚蠢的说法。

entries.definition: a fashion that everyone follows for a while
driven mad by strong feeling
entries.definitionCN: 被强烈情绪逼得失常的

entries.definition: a line pressed into cloth or paper
entries.definitionCN: 布料或纸上压出的折痕

entries.definition: mentally ill or wildly foolish
entries.definitionCN: 精神失常或荒唐至极的

entries.definition: lacking good sense
out of control and full of energy
entries.definitionCN: 失去控制且充满蛮劲的

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with cracks in a pot, then move to a cracked mind and to a passion with no measure.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从罐子上的裂缝开始，再到裂了缝的脑子，最后到没有分寸的痴迷。

normal.en: Crazy comes from a word for cracked, and a cracked pot cannot hold water.
normal.cn: crazy 来自「裂」这个词，裂了的罐子存不住水。

normal.en: A cracked mind lets strange ideas leak out.
normal.cn: 脑子裂了缝，古怪的念头就漏出来。

normal.en: Being crazy about a film is a happy crack in the heart.
normal.cn: 对一部电影着迷，是心里一条快乐的裂缝。

normal.en: A crazy plan is a bridge with no supports.
normal.cn: 荒唐的计划，是一座没有支柱的桥。

normal.en: Noise repeated all day can crack anyone's calm.
normal.cn: 噪声一整天不停，能敲裂任何人的平静。

abstract.en: Picture a hairline crack running down a clay pot.
abstract.cn: 想象一道发丝般的裂缝从陶罐上延伸下来。

abstract.en: Picture a man laughing in the rain with a chair on his head.
abstract.cn: 想象一个头顶椅子在雨里大笑的人。

abstract.en: Picture a map with the roads drawn in the wrong places.
abstract.cn: 想象一张把路画错位置的地图。

examples.en: He is crazy about fast cars.
examples.cn: 他对快车着迷。

examples.en: It was a crazy idea, but it worked.
examples.cn: 那是个疯狂的想法，但它奏效了。

examples.en: The children drove their mother crazy with noise.
examples.cn: 孩子们吵得妈妈要发疯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 crazy 记成 crack（裂）加 y：脑子裂了缝，人就成了 crazy。

root: 源自中古英语 crasen（碎裂）；crazy 本指「满是裂缝、不结实的」，后指「脑子出了裂缝」即发疯，再引申为极度着迷与荒唐。

sensesIntro.en: From a cracked thing, to a mind that loses order, to a fondness that has no limit.
sensesIntro.cn: 从裂了的东西，到失去秩序的脑子，最后到没有限度的喜欢。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crack opening in something that should be whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：本该完整的东西上裂开一道缝。

branches.en: A mind with a crack no longer follows one line.
branches.cn: 裂了缝的脑子不再沿着一条线走。

branches.en: Passion also breaks the usual limits of attention.
branches.cn: 痴迷同样打破了注意力的常规限度。

branches.en: A plan with no support looks like a cracked wall.
branches.cn: 没有支撑的计划，像一堵裂开的墙。

branches.en: Both are states where measure has been lost.
branches.cn: 两者都是失去分寸的状态。

branches.en: Love and folly both ignore what others call sense.
branches.cn: 痴迷与荒唐，都不理别人所谓的分寸。

intro.en: Crazy begins with the base craze and takes the endings -y, -ily and -iness.
intro.cn: crazy 以词基 craze 为底，加上 -y、-ily 与 -iness 等词尾。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; Latin has no share in this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词根属日耳曼语，拉丁语与它无关。

items.meaningCN: 满是裂缝的，继而指发疯
items.exampleCN: 这个计划听起来很疯狂。

items.example: Each idea was crazier than the last.
items.exampleCN: 每个主意都比上一个更荒唐。

items.example: That was the craziest week of my life.
items.exampleCN: 那是我一生中最疯狂的一周。

items.example: He drove crazily down the hill.

items.exampleCN: 到早晨，那股疯狂劲就过去了。
这种玩具成了一阵风潮。

items.example: A crazed look crossed his face.

items.meaningCN: 被关久了而烦躁不安的
items.example: The crew grew stir-crazy below deck.
items.exampleCN: 船员在甲板下憋得烦躁起来。

definition_en: the thick fatty part of milk, a soft substance for the skin, or the best part of something
core_image: 牛奶静置后表面浮起一层厚厚的白色脂膜
scene: 牛奶在盆里放了一夜，表面浮起一层厚厚的白脂。She spooned the cream off the top of the milk.
sceneCN: 这里 cream 指「奶油」（第 1 个义项：牛奶上层浮起的脂肪）；句意是她把牛奶上层的奶油舀了出来。

senses.title: The rich top of milk
senses.definition: the thick fatty part of milk
senses.definitionCN: 牛奶中浓厚含脂的部分
senses.example: She added cream to her coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 她往咖啡里加了奶油。
senses.why: Milk lets its richest part rise to the top.
senses.whyCN: 牛奶让最肥厚的那部分升到上面。

senses.title: A soft cream for the skin
senses.definition: a thick soft substance put on the skin
senses.definitionCN: 涂在皮肤上的浓稠柔软物质
senses.example: Apply the cream twice a day.
senses.exampleCN: 每天涂两次乳霜。
senses.why: Skin is fed with something as soft as milk fat.
senses.whyCN: 皮肤也需要像奶脂一样柔软的东西来滋养。

senses.title: The best of a group
senses.definition: the best people or things in a group
senses.definitionCN: 一群人中最优秀的人或物
senses.example: These players are the cream of the team.
senses.exampleCN: 这些球员是队里的精华。
senses.why: The best always rises, as fat does.
senses.whyCN: 最好的总像奶脂一样浮上来。

intro.en: Cream comes from Latin cremor, a thick juice, through Late Latin and Old French cresme.
intro.cn: cream 源自拉丁语 cremor（浓稠的汁液），经晚期拉丁语与古法语 cresme 进入英语。

items.en: Cremor meant a thick liquid from plants.
items.cn: cremor 指植物中浓稠的汁液。

items.en: Crama named the rich part of milk.
items.cn: crama 指牛奶中浓厚的那部分。

items.en: Cresme named the fatty layer on milk.
items.cn: cresme 指牛奶表面那层脂肪。

items.en: Cream named the rich top of milk.
items.cn: cream 指牛奶上层浓厚的那一层。

items.en: It widened to skin creams and to the best of anything.
items.cn: 它扩展到护肤霜，以及任何事物中最好的部分。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that rhyme with cream, and the meaning group names other soft or rich substances.
note.cn: 形近组收集与 cream 押韵的词，近义组列出其他柔软或浓厚的东西。

entries.definition: pictures the mind makes during sleep
entries.definitionCN: 睡眠中头脑造出的画面

entries.definition: to cry out in a high loud voice
entries.definitionCN: 用又高又响的声音喊叫

a liquid rubbed into the skin
a soft wet mixture
the most important quality of a thing

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with fat rising on milk, then move to a jar of skin cream and to the best of a team.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从牛奶上浮起的脂肪开始，再到一罐护肤霜，最后到一队人里的精华。

normal.en: Cream is what milk gives when it is left alone.
normal.cn: 奶油是牛奶静置之后交出来的东西。

normal.en: The richest part always floats: that is the first law.
normal.cn: 最肥厚的那层总会浮起，这是第一条规律。

normal.en: A jar of cream softens a dry face like milk on dry bread.
normal.cn: 一罐乳霜润开干燥的脸，就像牛奶浇在干面包上。

normal.en: The cream of the class sits in the front row.
normal.cn: 班级的精华坐在第一排。

normal.en: Ice cream keeps the same soft richness, only colder.
normal.cn: 冰淇淋保留了同样的柔滑浓厚，只是更冷。

abstract.en: Picture a white layer forming on still milk.
abstract.cn: 想象静止的牛奶上结成一层白。

abstract.en: Picture a spoon lifting a soft peak of cream.
abstract.cn: 想象一把勺子舀起一尖柔软的奶油。

abstract.en: Picture a few golden apples on top of a full basket.
abstract.cn: 想象满筐苹果最上面那几个金黄的。

examples.en: He likes strawberries with cream.
examples.cn: 他喜欢草莓配奶油。

examples.en: Put some cream on your hands before bed.
examples.cn: 睡前在手上涂一些乳霜。

examples.en: These five students are the cream of the school.
examples.cn: 这五名学生是全校的精华。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 cream 记成 c（奶）加 ream（一大叠）：牛奶上浮出的那一层，就是奶油。

root: 源自拉丁语 cremor（浓稠的汁液），经晚期拉丁语与古法语 cresme 进入英语，本指牛奶上层浮起的浓厚脂肪，后指乳霜，并由「浮起的最好部分」引申为精华。

sensesIntro.en: From the fat floating on milk, to the cream on the skin, to the best that rises in any group.
sensesIntro.cn: 从牛奶上浮起的脂肪，到涂在皮肤上的乳霜，最后到任何群体里浮起的精华。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick white layer rising on still milk.
core.cn: 核心意象：静止的牛奶上浮起厚厚一层白。

branches.en: The fattiest part of milk gathers at the surface.
branches.cn: 牛奶最肥的部分聚在表面。

branches.en: A soft thick substance soothes the skin.
branches.cn: 柔软浓稠的东西能安抚皮肤。

branches.en: The best people rise the way fat does.
branches.cn: 最优秀的人像奶脂一样浮上来。

branches.en: Both are rich, soft and spread on something.
branches.cn: 两者都浓厚柔软，都能涂抹在别物上。

branches.en: From a face to a team, the best layer is called cream.
branches.cn: 从一张脸到一支队伍，最好的那层都叫 cream。

intro.en: Cream is a base word from Latin cremor, extended by -y, -ery and -iness.
intro.cn: cream 是源自拉丁语 cremor 的词根词，由 -y、-ery、-iness 等词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The thick juice base crem- also appears in cremate and in creamery.
latinIntro.cn: 表示浓稠汁液的词基 crem- 也出现在 cremate 与 creamery 中。

items.meaning: the act of mixing to a soft mass
items.meaningCN: 搅拌成柔滑糊状的过程
items.exampleCN: 把黄油搅成糊需要时间。

items.meaningCN: 像奶油一样柔滑浓厚的
items.example: The soup is thick and creamy.

items.meaning: a place that makes dairy products

items.example: The creaminess comes from the fat.
They shared a bowl of ice cream.
items.exampleCN: 他们分吃了一碗冰淇淋。

definition_en: to make something new that did not exist before
core_image: 一张白纸上第一次画出一扇门，推开就是新房间
scene: 白纸上本来什么都没有，她一笔画出第一扇门。The writer created a whole world in three pages.
sceneCN: 这里 create 指「创造」（第 1 个义项：从无到有地做出新东西）；句意是作者用三页纸创造了一整个世界。

senses.title: To make something new
senses.definition: to make something new that did not exist before
senses.definitionCN: 做出以前不存在的全新事物
senses.example: They created a garden on the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在屋顶上造了一个花园。
senses.why: A blank space waits for the first line.
senses.whyCN: 一片空白总在等第一笔。

senses.title: To make a work of art
senses.definition: to produce a work of art or writing
senses.definitionCN: 产出艺术作品或文字作品
senses.example: She created a character we all remember.
senses.exampleCN: 她创作了一个我们都记得的角色。
senses.why: A story begins as nothing and then has a face.
senses.whyCN: 故事从无开始，然后长出一张脸。

senses.title: To cause a situation
senses.definition: to cause a situation or a problem to happen
senses.definitionCN: 使某种状况或问题发生
senses.example: The new road created a lot of noise.
senses.exampleCN: 新修的路带来了很多噪声。
senses.why: Every new thing pushes the old arrangement aside.
senses.whyCN: 每件新东西都会把旧的安排挤到一边。

intro.en: Create comes from Latin creare, to make or bring forth, a word related to crescere, to grow.
intro.cn: create 源自拉丁语 creare（制造、使生成），与 crescere（生长）同源。

items.en: Creare meant to make, bring forth or appoint.
items.cn: creare 意为制造、使产生或任命。

items.en: Crescere, to grow, shared the same old root.
items.cn: 表示生长的 crescere 与它共用一个古老词根。

items.en: Creatio named the act of making.
items.cn: creatio 指制造这一行为。

items.en: Create entered English as a word for divine making.
items.cn: create 进入英语时，多指神明造物。

items.en: It now covers art, jobs, problems and accounts.
items.cn: 今天它涵盖艺术创作、就业、问题与账户。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words near create in shape, and the meaning group names other words for bringing something into being.
note.cn: 形近组收集形状接近 create 的词，近义组列出其他表示「使某物出现」的说法。

entries.definition: a living animal or being
to burn a body to ashes
a large box for carrying goods
to form something from parts
to think of and build something new
to bring something into existence

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with an empty page, then move to a story and to a change nobody asked for.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一张空页开始，再到一个故事，最后到一场没人要求的变化。

normal.en: Create and grow share a root: to create is to let something grow out of nothing.
normal.cn: create 与「生长」同根：创造就是让东西从无里长出来。

normal.en: The first line on a blank page is always the bravest.
normal.cn: 白纸上的第一笔，总是最勇敢的一笔。

normal.en: A writer creates people who never breathe but stay alive.
normal.cn: 作家创造的人从不呼吸，却一直活着。

normal.en: A new road creates noise as well as shortcuts.
normal.cn: 新路带来捷径，也带来噪声。

normal.en: To create an account is to open a small new room.
normal.cn: 创建一个账户，就是开出一间小小的新房间。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil touching white paper for the first time.
abstract.cn: 想象一支铅笔第一次碰到白纸。

abstract.en: Picture a door drawn on a wall, opening inward.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上画着一扇朝里开的门。

abstract.en: Picture a small seed pushing soil upward.
abstract.cn: 想象一粒小种子把泥土顶起来。

examples.en: The company plans to create two hundred jobs.
examples.cn: 这家公司计划创造两百个就业岗位。

examples.en: He created the whole design on a single sheet.
examples.cn: 他在一张纸上完成了整个设计。

examples.en: Loud music can create tension between neighbours.
examples.cn: 大声的音乐会在邻里之间造成紧张。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 create 记成 cre（生长）加 ate：让原本没有的东西长出来，就是创造。

root: 源自拉丁语 creare（制造、使生成、任命），与 crescere（生长）同源，本指使某物生成，后指从无到有地造出，也指引起某种状况。

sensesIntro.en: From a blank page to a made world and to the changes that follow it.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一张白纸，到被造出的世界，最后到随之而来的种种变化。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a first line appearing on empty paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：空白的纸上出现第一笔。

branches.en: Something new is drawn where nothing stood.
branches.cn: 在原本空无的地方画出了新东西。

branches.en: A made character can outlive the hand that drew it.
branches.cn: 被创作的角色能比画它的手活得更久。

branches.en: Every new thing also makes old things move.
branches.cn: 每件新东西也会叫旧东西让位。

branches.en: To create a thing and to create a story share one gesture.
branches.cn: 造物与创作，共用同一个动作。

branches.en: Works and problems both begin with someone acting.
branches.cn: 作品与麻烦，都始于有人动手。

intro.en: Create grows from the Latin making base cre-, with forms in -es, -ed, -ing and nouns in -ion and -or.
intro.cn: create 从拉丁语表示制造的词基 cre- 长出，带 -es、-ed、-ing 等变形，及 -ion、-or 等名词。

latinIntro.en: The making base creare also shapes creation, creator and creature.
latinIntro.cn: 表示制造的词基 creare 也构成 creation、creator 与 creature。

items.meaning: to bring something new into being

items.example: She is creating a new pattern.

items.meaning: the act or result of making
the power to make new things

definition_zh: 有创造力的；创作性的；创意人员

scene: 桌上散着纸片和线头，他随手把它们拧成一个奇怪的小装置。She found a creative solution to the noise problem.
sceneCN: 这里 creative 指「有创造力的」（第 1 个义项：善于想出并做出新东西）；句意是她为噪声问题想出了一个有创意的办法。

senses.title: Full of new ideas
senses.definition: able to think of new and original ideas
senses.definitionCN: 能想出新颖独到的点子
senses.example: She is the most creative person in the class.
senses.exampleCN: 她是班上最有创造力的人。
senses.why: The mind refuses the first easy answer.
senses.whyCN: 这样的脑子不肯接受第一个省事的答案。

senses.title: Involving imagination
senses.definition: involving imagination in making something
senses.definitionCN: 在制作过程中需要想象力的

senses.exampleCN: 他在学校教创意写作。
senses.why: Some work begins with a blank page, not a rule.
senses.whyCN: 有些工作从一张白纸开始，而不是从一条规则开始。

senses.title: A person paid for ideas
senses.definition: a person whose job is to produce ideas
senses.definitionCN: 以想出点子为职业的人
senses.example: The agency hired two creatives.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司聘了两名创意人员。
senses.why: Every industry needs someone to imagine first.
senses.whyCN: 每个行业都需要有人先想一步。

items.en: Creare meant to make or bring forth.
items.cn: creare 意为制造或使产生。

items.en: Creativus named the power to make.
items.cn: creativus 指制造的能力。

items.en: Creative described the power of a maker.
items.cn: creative 形容创造者的能力。

items.en: It widened to art and to original thought.
items.cn: 它扩展到艺术与独到的想法。

entries.definition: a person who makes something new
the act or result of making
acting only after something happens

entries.definition: new and not copied from others

good at thinking up new things

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a pile of odd pieces, then move to a blank page and to a paid idea.

normal.en: Creative is create with -ive: the quality of being able to make.

normal.en: An agency pays creatives for the ideas it cannot order.
normal.cn: 公司花钱请创意人员，因为他们买不来被命令出的点子。

abstract.en: Picture a drawing that follows no straight line.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅没有一条直线的画。

abstract.en: Picture a light bulb drawn where a full stop should be.
abstract.cn: 想象本该是句号的地方画了一只灯泡。

examples.cn: 她用很少的钱也能做出新花样。

examples.cn: 学校办了一个创意写作社。

examples.en: The firm hires young creatives every spring.
examples.cn: 这家公司每年春天都招年轻创意人员。

sensesIntro.en: From a mind that refuses the easy answer, to work that begins with a blank page, to people paid for ideas.

branches.en: A creative job turns ideas into things others can use.
branches.cn: 创意工作把点子变成别人能用的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin making base creare lies under creative, creation and creator.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语表示制造的词基 creare 垫在 creative、creation 与 creator 之下。
